name: umt-captcha-fill
description: Unofficial Firefox extension that copies the plain-text captcha into the captcha field on the UMT student portal login page.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files test store dist node_modules package.json package-lock.json '.*'
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test store dist node_modules package.json package-lock.json '.*'
